$comment: Decisions for the Figma token sync. Edit here when a decision changes, then re-run diff.mjs. See docs/2026-10-06-figma-token-sync-plan.md.

semantic.$comment: Figma Theme names Background/*, Content/*, Border/* map to systemColors keys by lowercasing and joining with '-'. Where Figma's name differs from ours, systemColors carries the Figma name as an alias (figmaNameAliases in src/tokens/colors/system.ts) and our older name is listed under legacy. Nothing is renamed in this pass.

component.$comment: Figma Button/Background/<Variant>/<State> maps to button-<variant>-<state>; other component names lowercase and join with '-'. Overrides cover the rest.

primitive.$comment: Figma Color/<Hue>/<Stop> maps to referenceColors[hue][stop]. Stops are zero-padded to two digits. Alpha stops (ending in A) map to referenceColors.alpha['<hue>-<stop>a'].

shadow.$comment: Figma Shadow/<Level>/<1|2>/<Blur|Color> and the Elevation/* effect styles map to shadowPrimitives[mode][level].

typography.$comment: Figma text style name to v2TextStyles key.

weights.$comment: Decided 2026-10-06. emphasis is new; semibold and light stay as deprecated aliases pointing at the new values.

proposed.$comment: Ours only, not in Figma. Kept and flagged 'proposed' for handoff. Decided 2026-10-06; naming revisited after the Scaligent tally.
